# Workflows (basename, one per line) held to the staged cache-mode rules F to J of
# check-cache-mode.rb: workflow-level `cache-mode: none`, an explicit job-level value on every
# job that restores, saves or calls a reusable workflow, and the validate-main /
# validate-untrusted caller split where main saves a cache. Empty in the policy pull request;
# the workflow pull request that adds `cache-mode` to a workflow adds its name here in the same
# change (docs/untrusted-readonly-cache.md, section 4.1). The always-on rules A to E and the
# actions: write rule need no entry.
